name: Nishiazai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishiazai town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal and vertical strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Nishiazai in Shiga Prefecture, dissolved on 2010-01-01.

features.role: Nishiazai town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal and vertical strokes
